Fk Roblox - Cookie file Auto Cleaner
Deletes leftover Roblox files and cookies so you don't get chase banned after raging or hopping off alt/other accounts.

-
How to setup (takes 1 min):

1. Download & install AutoHotkey v2 from: 
https://www.autohotkey.com

2. Make a new blank text file somewhere (like AHK folder), name it whatever you want but make it end with `.ahk` (like FkRoblox.ahk).

3. Right click your new `.ahk` file, click "Edit Script".

4. OPEN THE SCRIPT and PASTE everything from this post in there (replace everything already in it).

5. REALLY IMPORTANT: At the top of the script, find this line:
   `C:\Users\black\AppData\Local\Roblox\LocalStorage\RobloxCookies.dat`
   - Change `black` to your Windows username (the folder name you see in C:\Users\).
   - Should look like: `C:\Users\yourusername\AppData\Local\Roblox\LocalStorage\RobloxCookies.dat`
6. Save and close the editor!

7. Now just double-click the `.ahk` file to run!  
   It shows tray tips when it does stuff, and will handle everything automatically.

(you must run the .ahk file everytime you start windows)

-
What it does / features:

- Deletes leftover Roblox cookie/session file when you close Roblox (to help prevent chase bans when account hopping)

- Admin auto-relaunch: If Windows blocks the delete, it'll auto-retry as admin (you'll get a UAC popup) so it actually nukes the files

- Logs everything to a .log file in the same folder, so you can see what got deleted

- Auto-kills Roblox crash handlers and launchers beforehand (no leftover Roblox stuff running)  

- PowerShell fallback as a last resort if couldnt delete
- Easy to setup
- OPEN SOURCE
- Safe: Only touches Roblox session/cookie files, that's it

-
IMPORTANT (Prevents Extra Bans):  
This script REDUCES the risk of chase bans by instantly removing the main cookie/session file right after you close Roblox, making it harder for Roblox to link your alts/mains.  

BUT:  
You should still do the normal error 600 bypass method when swapping back to main after raging or using alts. This script is a helper; always use standard precautions for max safety.
